edges.effect_quant: The strongest quantitative studies point in a protective direction, but the pooled magnitude varies across populations and methods.
edges.mechanism: Tighter glycemic control should slow neuropathy by reducing glucose-driven nerve and microvascular damage over time.
edges.summary: The strongest piece here is the 2022 Carvajal-Moreno systematic review in J Clin Med, which ties intensive glycaemic control to peripheral neuropathy in a direction that later studies largely support. That makes this edge more about calibrating magnitude and context than arguing over whether the signal exists at all.
edges.caveats: Healthier-user bias, screening intensity, and baseline risk can all inflate apparent benefit in observational work, so the magnitude should be read conservatively.
